title: leontodon montanus subsp. pseudotaraxaci
intro: Leontodon montanus subsp. pseudotaraxaci, commonly known as mountain hawk's beard, is a subspecies of the Leontodon montanus plant, a type of dandelion-like flowering plant. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a digestive aid, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of mountain hawk's beard include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
